customer: Caller from Texas, a new parent, was frustrated that she can't find the title for the minivan she's still paying off and thought she'd have to order a duplicate before she could sell it.
agent: Customer asked whether she needed her minivan's title or a duplicate to sell it while the loan is still open. Explained per 'Selling a car you are still paying off' that her lender holds the title or electronic title record, so she doesn't need it in hand or a duplicate. At the appointment we confirm what she owes and pay the lender directly from our offer, and if the offer is more than the payoff she gets the difference. Suggested she get a payoff letter before coming in to speed things up.
